note: Adapted from Constantino's (1995) revision, originally in English. The soldier and the major worker are described; the alate is described in the comparison section for this species in the original. Soldier measurements: 6 colonies, 6 soldiers, head length 5.40—5.80 mm, maximum head width 4.60—5.00 mm, head height without postmentum 2.90—3.10 mm, frontal tube length 0.22—0.27 mm, left mandible length 2.30—2.50 mm, curvature 0.65—0.80 mm, left mandible M1—M2 distance 0.45—0.67 mm.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate not particularly similar to the other species of the genus; recognizable by its very long transparent wings, small triangular fontanelle, numerous setae on the vertex, relatively small compound eyes, and the contrast between the dark brown head and the chestnut pronotum. Soldier very distinctive: head elongated and densely covered with short setae, mandibles short and stout, thoracic spines weak. The most similar soldier is S. dirus, which is less elongated……

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule elongated, the sides parallel; posterior margin of the head round. Frontal tube projecting, the opening not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length and width nearly equal; lateral corners about right-angled; median lobe short. Antennae 19-segmented. Postmentum slightly constricted at the middle. Mandibles short and stout.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule and postclypeus densely covered with short setae; fontanelle small and round. Antennae 20-segmented. Thoracic tergite spines weak. Mandibles similar to those of S. dirus, the molar plate narrow, the basal notch obtuse-angled. Hindgut very similar to that of S. barbatus, the main midgut extension of the mixed segment slightly more slender.
